block.description:
Status message enclosed in decorator characters. Example: . AesCompliant™ CommonRails now starting . All input is sanitized through LineFormatter to enforce CamelCase naming convention. No UPPER_SNAKE_CASE or raw capitalized keywords will appear in output (except preserved acronyms above).
™ is applied only to the parent-class-prefix value (see append-trademark-scope). Set append-trademark-scope to change which element receives the treatment symbol.
special-spellings: comma-separated words with exact casing that override the normal CamelCase/InitialCap sanitization. Any occurrence (case-insensitive) is replaced with the spelling here.
proper-nouns: comma-separated place names, institutions, and geographic proper nouns whose first letter must always be uppercased. Multi-word entries (e.g. "Chapel Hill") are matched as a phrase. Any occurrence (case-insensitive) is replaced with the InitialCap form defined here.
NOTE: Do NOT repeat the class name in the message body. Block 4 [Current: @ClassName] already identifies the owning class. Repeating it causes double-name output (e.g. "AntivirusScanner AntivirusScanner").

starts.description: canonical: the output form printed in all component lines. alternatives: comma-separated input forms that get replaced by the canonical form during message sanitization. Change canonical to alter how all lifecycle prints read. Examples: "starts" → ". WebExpress™ starts ." "is starting" → ". WebExpress™ is starting ." "now starting" → ". WebExpress™ now starting ."

parent-class-prefix.description: enabled: if true, the parent/owning class simple name is inserted before the module name in Block 5 lifecycle messages. append-trademark: if true, ™ is appended to the parent class name. separator: character(s) between parent class and module name.

grace.description: Controls the grayscale fade-in animation before the final line print. fade-steps: number of ANSI 256-color grades (236..255). fade-delay-ms: pause between each grade. post-fade-delay-ms: pause after fade completes before final print.

control.description: colored-output: master toggle for ANSI color sequences. reset-after-line: emit ANSI reset at end of each line. default-color: ColorPalette constant for non-highlighted text. trademark-color: ColorPalette constant for ™ symbol rendering.
